_doc: Ytor för make_surface.py: sömlösa, stiliserade marktexturer. prompt beskriver bara materialet; husets stil och instruktioner för platt, sömlös vy läggs till automatiskt. normal = styrka på normalkartan (0 = ingen).

planks.prompt: weathered wooden floor planks running vertically, warm brown wood with soft grain, a few knots, slightly darker gaps between boards

dirt.prompt: bare forest ground soil, warm brown earth with a few tiny pebbles and soft darker patches

grass.prompt: short lush lawn seen from directly above, a dense carpet of grass blade tips and small clumps in fresh greens with lighter yellow-green tips, no individual tall blades

meadow.prompt: wild meadow ground seen from directly above, dense green grass carpet with scattered tiny yellow and white flower heads seen face-on as small round dots, and clover leaves

path.prompt: trodden forest footpath of packed light brown earth with small embedded pebbles and a few dry leaves

road.prompt: old cobblestone road of rounded light grey stones tightly packed, soft warm dust between the stones

cliff.prompt: stylized cliff rock face with large flat planes and soft fractures, light grey stone with cool blue-grey shadows

stone.prompt: large smooth rounded grey flagstones and rock surface with soft cracks, light grey with subtle warm tint

gravel.prompt: loose gravel of small rounded grey and beige pebbles seen from above

riverbed.prompt: shallow riverbed of smooth rounded pebbles in soft blue-grey, beige and brown, wet sheen

mud.prompt: soft wet dark brown mud with gentle ripples and a few puddle highlights

sand.prompt: fine warm beach sand with gentle wind ripples and a few tiny shell fragments

forestfloor.prompt: forest floor seen from directly above, flat mix of moss patches, pine needles, small twigs and fallen leaves lying flat on dark earth

snow.prompt: fresh soft snow surface with gentle drifts and faint blue shadows

pondbed.prompt: murky pond bottom seen from above, fine dark gravel and silt with a few sunken brown leaves, small twigs and tiny green algae patches
